name: Jev
tagline: Adds typed triage - category, severity, yes-or-no - to a Jev pipeline
description: A triage seat for teams that already run TypeSafe Jev. Incoming items are sorted into a category, given a severity, and answered with a plain go or no-go, all through typed calls instead of free text. The prerequisite is real: the Jev side has to be wired into LiteLLM first, and any other call path means extra setup.
author: NeuralCatAccel
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
